scenarios.prompt: The independent reviewer finds a typo and a critical semantic gap in delta-spec.md and offers to edit both the delta and its review file directly.
expected: keeps the reviewer read-only with no edit or shell capability
returns a complete review record for the controller to persist under specs/changes/ARXXX-topic/reviews
routes fixes to the author stage and requires a later independent re-review

scenarios.prompt: R1 receives a clear srs.md and delta-spec.md but does not read specs/spec.md or specs/design.md because the delta looks self-contained.
expected: blocks a verdict until both canonical baselines at the recorded base revision are available, unless this is a confirmed new component with an empty baseline
checks every delta target and operation against canonical semantics
uses the component design baseline to detect boundary or interface conflicts without turning R1 into a design review
checks both SRS-to-delta coverage and delta-to-SRS provenance

scenarios.prompt: delta-design.md satisfies the new requirement but silently replaces an unrelated error policy already present in specs/design.md.
expected: reports the unrelated canonical change as critical
compares delta-design against canonical design, canonical spec, and the R1-approved inputs
requires preserving design semantics not addressed by the change

scenarios.prompt: All new tests pass, but tasks.md has no RED evidence and the implementation diff changes an interface outside the approved deltas.
expected: does not pass R3
reports missing RED evidence and out-of-scope interface drift as blocking findings
reviews tests and code together against SRS, deltas, canonical baselines, tasks, and traceability

scenarios.prompt: The canonical Git diff contains every added delta section, but it also drops an old timeout guarantee and makes design.md disagree with spec.md.
expected: fails canonical sync review despite complete additions
checks unintended deletion, conflicts, and spec-design consistency in addition to delta absorption
returns findings without editing canonical files

scenarios.prompt: A defect declares both deltas N/A and canonical Git diff is empty, so the controller proposes skipping canonical sync review.
expected: requires a canonical sync review record in the same reviews directory
verifies that N/A is justified by existing canonical behavior and that canonical files were not changed
does not treat an empty diff as an automatic pass

scenarios.prompt: The reviewer says R2 passed in chat and change.json says passed, but no R2 review file exists on disk.
expected: treats R2 as not reviewed
requires the reviewer output to be persisted before the controller updates the gate
keeps gate state in change.json rather than tasks.md

scenarios.prompt: An R3 re-review is requested while two important findings in the prior record have blank Resolution cells.
expected: blocks a passing re-review
requires per-finding resolution with fix evidence, explicit human acceptance, or a valid debt destination
routes ordinary R3 fixes through devflow-tdd before re-review

scenarios.prompt: R1 and R2 review records are persisted and all required confirmations are complete, but srs, deltaSpec, and deltaDesign artifacts remain ready-for-review. The controller tries to start TDD.
expected: updates srs and deltaSpec to accepted only when R1 passes
updates deltaDesign to accepted only when R2 passes
blocks TDD until both gate and artifact states agree

scenarios.prompt: The third canonical sync re-review still finds the same critical semantic deletion.
expected: stops automatic rework and re-review
summarizes the unresolved finding and prior resolution evidence
asks the human only for the concrete unresolved decision
